sum: Apex Critical Metals Corp. engages in the acquisition, exploration, development, and evaluation of mineral properties in Canada and the United States. The company explores for rare earth elements and niobium carbonatite deposits. Its flagship project is the Rift Rare Earth Project that covers an area of approximately 2,217 hectares across 27 parcels located in southeastern Nebraska, the United States. The company was formerly known as Eagle Bay Resources Corp. and changed its name to Apex Critical Metals Corp. in May 2024. Apex Critical Metals Corp. was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
